t: Hammaskir bayit lachabero al mi chal chobat biur
s: Hammaskir bayit lachabero al mi chal chobat biur ubo z' seipim: hammaskir bayit lachabero qodem techillat lel y"d uqenao hassoker beechad mehadderakim shessekirut bayit niqneh bo, dehaynu bekesep o bishtar o bachazaqa o beqinyan sudar, vehammaskir yatza min habbayit usegaro velo masar et hammapteach leyad hassoker ad leachar shekkebar niknas lel y"d — chayyab hammaskir libdoq et habbayit shehiskir ap al pi shehu lo yikkanes bo kol yeme happesach veim ken lo yabo leekol mechametz shebbetoko, vegam eno ober alayv be"bal yimmatze", lepi shebbevadday nityaesh mimmennu vehipqiro kesheyyatza min habbayit veazab sham chametz, mikkol maqom kevan sheggup habbayit shel hammaskir (veeno qanuy lehassoker ella ladur betoko, vegam hechametz haya shello, ubitchillat lel y"d sheaz hu iqqar zeman chiyyub habbediqa kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"a) haya habbayit adayin meukkab etzel hammaskir, shello haya hassoker yakol likkanes letoko mechamat shehammapteach haya adayin beyad hammaskir, lepikak, beshaa zo, dehaynu techillat kenisat hallayla, chal chiyyub habbediqa al hammaskir, veshub lo nipqa mimmennu ap leachar shenniknas hassoker letoko. Uleachar sheyyigmor hammaskir millibdoq yebattel kol hechametz shello matza bibdiqato. Veap al pi shekkebar hipqiro belibbo kesheyyatza min habbayit, ap al pi ken chayyab hu lachazor ulebattelo beperush achar habbediqa ketiqqun chakamim shettiqqenu lehotzi habbittul bepiv. Vegam hassoker chayyab lebattel kol hechametz shebbabbayit, vaapillu im eno niknas ladur betoko ad achar happesach, lepi shemmiyyad sheqqana habbayit beechad mehadderakim shessekirut qarqa niqneh bo — zaka gam ken bechametz sheazab sham hammaskir, shehare kebar hipqiro hammaskir, vekol debar hepqer hammunnach babbayit hammuskar lassoker zaka bo hassoker, kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman r"s, veim ken mah shehammaskir mebattel en moil kelum latzet yede chobat taqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu lebattel achar habbediqa, shehare en hechametz shello ella shel hassoker, lepikak chayyab hassoker lebattelo:

Abal im masar lo hammapteach qodem kenisat techillat lel y"d, apillu im chazar hassoker vehipqid hammapteach etzel hammaskir — mechuyyab hu littelo miyyad hammaskir velibdoq, apillu im lo yiknos ladur bo ad leachar happesach, kevan sheen hammaskir meakkeb al hassoker millikkanes labbayit, shehare kebar masar lo hammapteach. Veken im hu bayit sheeno naul, sheen tzarik mapteach, chayyab hassoker libdoq. Veachar habbediqa yebattel (g) ketaqqanat chakamim, vegam hammaskir yebattel beperush ap shekkebar hipqiro belibbo:

Vekol zeh keshekkebar qenao hassoker beechad mehadderakim shessekirut bayit niqneh bo qodem kenisat lel y"d shehu iqqar zeman chiyyub habbediqa, abal im lo qenao ad leachar kenisat lel y"d, vaapillu qenao qodem hallayla ella shessekaro letzorek yom y"d umimmennu vaelak, dehaynu shemmiyyom y"d vaelak hu rashshay liknos lehabbayit veladur betoko ad sop meshek zeman sekirato, venimtza shebbelel y"d shehu iqqar zeman chiyyub habbediqa lo haya adayin habbayit qanuy lehassoker kelal, lepikak chal al hammaskir chobat habbediqa:

Vekol zeh bemaskir, abal hammoker bayit lachabero veyatza mehabbayit usegaro vehalloqeach qenao beechad mehadderakim shehabbayit niqneh bo qodem lel y"d, ap al pi shello masar hammapteach leyad halloqeach ad leachar kenisat lel y"d, ap al pi ken lo chal al hammoker chobat habbediqa, kevan shekkebar niqna gup habbayit lehalloqeach — hu chayyab libdoq ulebattel, vehammoker day lo bebittul bilbad:

Hassoker bayit mechabero beyom y"d o betok lel y"d leachar shekkebar abar zeman shehaya yakol hammaskir libdoq beto beoto zeman vehassoker eno yodea im bedaqo hammaskir im lav, im hammaskir o ishto ubene beto bair — yishal lahem im badequ. Ap al pi shedderek hakkesherim libdoq bitchillat lel y"d ketiqqun chakamim, vekol echad veechad miyyisrael bechezqat kasher hu, umin hassetam badaq kebar, ap al pi ken chayyab lishol, lepi shekkol hashshana haya habbayit bechezqat sheyyesh bo chametz ubachazaqa zo shemmin hassetam badequ atta ba lehotzio mechezqat chametz — en anu somekin al hachazaqa lekattechilla bemaqom sheepshar lebarer. Veim en hammaskir velo echad mibbene beto bair — somekin al hachazaqa veen tzarik libdoq, ella mebattelo vedayyo. Veim yesh mibbene beto bair, apillu im yadua lanu shehammaskir beatzmo lo badaq veechad mibbene beto omer shebbadaq hu, apillu hu ebed o qatan sheyyesh bo daat libdoq o ishsha — hare ellu neemanim, veen tzarik lachazor velibdoq, dekevan shebbediqat chametz hu middibre soperim heeminum chakamim:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehassoker bittel kol hechametz shebbetok hachadarim hammuskarim lo, abal im lo bittel ukebar higgia shaa shishshit sheeno yakol od lebattel — en lo lismok al bediqat nashim vaabadim uqetannim, vechayyab hu lachazor velibdoq bekol hachadarim hatztzerikim bediqa min hattora (ayyen siman tl"g). Veap al pi shehannashim neemanot apillu beissure tora kol shehaya beyadan letaqqen haissur, kegon nidda neemenet lomar shettobla hoil vehaya beyadah litbol, veken neemenet al hashshechita veal hanniqqur lomar sheshshachata veniqqera kehilkatam hoil vehaya beyadah lishchot ulenaqqer kehilkatam, mikkol maqom enah neemenet lomar shebbodqa kehilkot habbediqa ap al pi shehaya beyadah libdoq kahalaka, lepi shehabbediqa kehilkatah yesh bah torach gadol, vehannashim atzlaniyyot hen, vehen bodeqot qima veomerot "yapeh badaqnu", lepikak lo heeminu lahen chakamim ella bemaqom sheen tzarik bediqa ki im middibre soperim:

Hammaskir bayit lachabero bechezqat baduq, dehaynu shehitna immo beperush al menat shehu baduq venimtza sheeno baduq, ap al pi shehiskir lo beyom y"d venimtza shekkebar nitchayyeb hammaskir babbediqa, apillu haki im omer hammaskir "eni rotzeh laasot mitzva", o sheeno lepanenu shehalak ledarko — chayyab hassoker libdoq, veeno yakol lachazor mimmiqqacho velomar shemmiqqacho haya betaut. Apillu im hu maqom sheen nohagin sham libdoq kol ish bebeto ella sokerin lahen anashim acherim sheyyibdequ lahem, venimtza shessoker zeh yesh lo mizzeh hepsed mamon, sheyyitztarek liskor mi sheyyibdoq lo bayit zeh — ap al pi ken eno yakol lachazor bo, lepi shevvadday bedato haya sheap im lo yihyeh baduq yitqayyem hammiqqach, shemmin hassetam noach leadam laasoq bemitzvot ben begupo (d) ben bemamono, umah shechazar bo akshav hu mippene dabar acher. Veyesh omerim shemmikkol maqom chayyab hammaskir lehachazir mah sheyyitztarek lehotzi sakar bead habbediqa, hoil vehitna immo beperush sheyyehe baduq. Veap al pi sheddato haya sheap im lo yihyeh baduq yitqayyem hammiqqach, mikkol maqom lo haya bedato limchol sekar habbediqa, sheen noach leadam laasot mitzva begupo o bemamono ella bemaqom sheen chesron kis, kegon lebarek al tallit shello, abal bechesron kis en noach lo kelal. Uleinyan halaka, yakol hammuchzaq lomar "qim li kassebara harishona".
